articles.title: Iran Hits US Navy Base in Bahrain, Causing Massive Damage
bullets: Iranian missiles struck the US Navy base in Bahrain, causing extensive damage.
Satellite images and news reports confirm the destruction at the base.
The attack, early in the conflict, raises tensions and could lead to a US response.
articles.original_title: Acting Navy secretary says Iran 'blew the hell out of' US Bahrain base

articles.title: List Shows 15 Men Who Still Expect Wives to Do All the Housework and Entertainment
bullets: The article profiles fifteen adult men who say they want a "traditional wife" to handle chores like washing dishes and even choose Netflix shows for them.
It highlights how some people still hold outdated ideas about gender roles in modern relationships.
The piece has sparked online debate about expectations of partnership and equality in marriage.
articles.original_title: 15 Fully Grown Men Who Expected Women To Help Them Through Every Step Of Life, Including Washing The Dishes And Logging Into Netflix

articles.title: Trump Calls Affordability Crisis "Fake" While White House Says It’s Real
bullets: Former President Donald Trump dismissed the housing affordability problem as a made‑up issue.
The White House and many economists say the crisis is real, with rising rents and home prices hurting families.
The disagreement is coming as midterm elections approach, adding political tension to the economic debate.
articles.original_title: President Trump can't decide if the affordability crisis is real or not

articles.title: Trump's Approval Rating Bounces Slightly After Record Lows
bullets: A new Reuters/Ipsos poll shows Trump's approval rating rising a little after weeks near historic lows.
The poll still places his support at a low level, but the uptick stops a steady decline.
The modest gain could help his political standing as he heads toward upcoming elections.
articles.original_title: Trump sees approval rating reprieve after weeks of record lows

articles.title: Off-Duty NYPD Officer Saves Driver’s Life in Brooklyn
bullets: An off‑duty NYPD officer performed CPR on a driver after a crash in Brooklyn.
The officer's quick actions are credited with rescuing the driver and preventing death.
The incident highlights how police officers can help even when they are not on duty.
articles.original_title: WATCH: Off-duty NYPD officer rescues driver in Brooklyn

articles.title: Former Anthropic researcher warns AI could kill humanity by decade's end
bullets: A former Anthropic AI researcher resigned and said the companies building advanced AI are putting humanity at risk.
He warned that AI could become powerful enough to kill us all by the end of the 2020s.
The warning adds to growing concerns about safety and regulation of increasingly capable AI systems.
He urges companies and policymakers to act now to prevent a possible catastrophic outcome.
articles.original_title: WATCH: Former AI researcher issues dire warning after resignation

articles.title: Minnesota Police Use Drone to Find Child Struggling in Pond
bullets: Police received a 911 call about a child appearing to be in trouble in a St. Paul pond.
A police drone was launched and quickly located the boy, guiding rescuers to the exact spot.
The rapid drone assistance helped rescue teams reach the child faster, showing how drones can speed up emergency responses.
articles.original_title: WATCH: Minnesota police drone locates child in pond

articles.title: BYD Employee Allegedly Whistles on Quality‑Control Misconduct
bullets: A BYD staff member is said to have reported internal fraud in the company’s quality‑control processes.
The alleged misconduct could affect the safety and reliability of BYD’s products.
The claim may lead to an internal investigation and could impact BYD’s reputation and sales.

articles.title: Gillian Anderson Shares Which LGBTQ+ Label She Identifies With, Fans Celebrate
bullets: The X‑Files star said in a recent interview that she feels most comfortable with the label “queer.”
She explained that the term reflects her attraction to people regardless of gender and fits her personal experience.
Her openness has been praised by LGBTQ+ fans and adds visibility to diverse sexual identities.
articles.original_title: Gillian Anderson Opens Up About Which LGBTQ+ Label Fits Her Best, And Queer Fans Are Ecstatic

articles.title: Mosquito-Borne Diseases Rise Across the United States
bullets: Health officials report a sharp increase in illnesses like West Nile virus, dengue and Zika this season.
The highest numbers of cases are being seen in Texas, Florida, California, and the Midwest states such as Missouri and Illinois.
People are urged to use insect repellent, wear long sleeves, and eliminate standing water to reduce mosquito bites.
articles.original_title: Mosquito-borne illnesses increasing in US. See map of affected states
